skill.summary: Etsy search optimization — long-tail keywords, tag research, competitor analysis, seasonal trends

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Etsy Keyword Research skill (Beta).
- Provides expert guidance on long-tail keywords, tag research, competitor analysis, and seasonal trends.
- Analyzes your Etsy shop and suggests actionable optimization opportunities.
- Delivers data-driven recommendations, implementation plans, and comparative strategy analysis.
- Outputs structured assessments, priority action items, tool suggestions, and KPIs to track.
- Does not integrate directly with the Etsy API; focuses on best-practice strategy.
